name: eido
description: A local-first canvas for connected thinking with your own AI API keys.

scripts.start: npm run ci:runtime --silent && npm run desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run ci:runtime --silent && npm run build -- --mode desktop-proof && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.build: npm run ci:runtime --silent && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:electron: npm run ci:runtime --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode main && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode profile-utility && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode preload && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode eido-cli-sea && node scripts/electron/profile-live-gateway-helper.mjs
scripts.desktop:package:dir: npm run ci:runtime --silent && vite build --mode desktop-proof && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run ci:runtime --silent && npm run desktop:package:dir && node scripts/electron/packaged-smoke.mjs
scripts.release:package: npm run ci:runtime --silent && npm run build -- --mode desktop-proof && npm run build:electron && node scripts/certification/package-certification.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run ci:runtime --silent && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:outside-build: npm run ci:runtime --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run ci:runtime --silent && npm run ci:toolchain && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.hooks:install: npm run ci:runtime --silent && git config core.hooksPath .githooks
scripts.ci:design-system: npm run ci:runtime --silent && node scripts/ci/design-system-drift.mjs && node scripts/design/sync-design-reference.mjs --check
scripts.test:browser: npm run ci:runtime --silent && playwright test --config playwright.interaction.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:health: npm run ci:runtime --silent && playwright test --config playwright.interaction.config.ts src/canvas/browserHealth.browser.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:smoke: npm run ci:runtime --silent && playwright test --config playwright.interaction.config.ts src/canvas/connectionPopover.browser.test.ts src/canvas/contextPeek.browser.test.ts src/canvas/resultFollowUp.browser.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:production: npm run ci:runtime --silent && npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.perf:timeline: npm run ci:runtime --silent && vitest run src/graph/timeline.bench.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.perf:save: npm run ci:runtime --silent && vitest run electron/profileSaveCost.perf.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.perf:store: npm run ci:runtime --silent && vitest run src/performance/storeReport.perf.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.perf:browser: npm run ci:runtime --silent && playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts
scripts.perf:rich-card:probe: npm run ci:runtime --silent && EIDO_RICH_CARD_MODE=probe playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts src/performance/richCardBaseline.perf.ts
scripts.perf:rich-card:correctness: npm run ci:runtime --silent && EIDO_RICH_CARD_MODE=correctness playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts src/performance/richCardBaseline.perf.ts
scripts.perf:rich-card:capture: npm run ci:runtime --silent && playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts src/performance/richCardBaseline.perf.ts
scripts.perf:browser:current: npm run ci:runtime --silent && EIDO_CURRENT_BOARD_DATA_FILE=${EIDO_CURRENT_BOARD_DATA_FILE:-$HOME/.eido/eido-v3-ideas.json} playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts -g "current saved Board"
scripts.perf:report: npm run ci:runtime --silent && vitest run src/performance/performanceReport.perf.test.ts src/performance/storeReport.perf.test.ts src/performance/graphIndexReport.perf.test.ts src/performance/persistenceReport.perf.test.ts src/performance/richCardReport.perf.test.ts --reporter=verbose
